# this test verifies the certificate generated allows us to connect to pypi.org
exec docker build -qt pypi-updater .

dependabot update go_modules dependabot/cli --updater-image pypi-updater
stderr '200 https://pypi.org:443/'

exec docker rmi -f pypi-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM python:3.13-bookworm

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && \
    python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip requests && \
    useradd -m dependabot && \
    mkdir -p /home/dependabot && \
    chown -R dependabot:dependabot /home/dependabot && \
    chgrp dependabot /etc/ssl/certs && chmod g+w /etc/ssl/certs

ENV REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

COPY --chown=dependabot:dependabot --chmod=755 run bin/run

USER dependabot
WORKDIR /home/dependabot

-- run --
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
python3 --version
python3 -c 'import requests; r = requests.get("https://pypi.org", timeout=30); print(f"{r.status_code} {r.url}"); r.raise_for_status()'
